en: Black‑and‑white view of a busy fishing harbor in a rocky coastal town. Numerous traditional wooden fishing boats with masts and small cabins are moored at wooden piers, some bearing identification numbers such as "LL 539." On the shore behind the harbor stand tightly packed wooden houses and boathouses with pitched roofs typical of Scandinavian coastal architecture. Low, rocky islands and a few isolated buildings are visible out in the water, suggesting an archipelago setting. The scene looks early‑20th‑century, likely captured as a photographic postcard.
